    if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip().replace("\xa0", "") == "":
        return True
    return False

    if isinstance(v, str):
        return v.strip().replace("\xa0", "")

    a = normalize_for_compare(a)

        return a > b

        return a > b

    # Otherwise, for the text/order-code scenario in the workbook, compare as strings.
